static randomMatColor(hue: hueTypes = '400') {
    const mainColors = [
      'red',
      'pink',
      'purple',
      'deepPurple',
      'indigo',
      'blue',
      'lightBlue',
      'cyan',
      'teal',
      'green',
      'lightGreen',
      'lime',
      'yellow',
      'amber',
      'orange',
      'deepOrange',
    ];

    const randomColor = mainColors[Math.floor(Math.random() * mainColors.length)];

    return (colors as Record<string, Color>)[randomColor][hue];
  }
